title: Central place for ErrorResult -> gRPC code translation in unified storage
answers: Where is HTTP/ErrorResult converted to a gRPC status code for unified storage metrics?
What function should a new call site use to derive a gRPC code from a resourcepb.ErrorResult?
body: pkg/storage/unified/resource/errors.go:grpcCodeFromErrorResult is the single function that converts a resourcepb.ErrorResult (HTTP code + Reason) into a grpc code; it replaced the old HTTP-only grpcCodeFromHTTPStatus. It is used by grpc_interceptor.go:UnaryRequestDurationInterceptor for request-duration metric labels and by search.go's VectorSearch metrics path. New call sites that need a gRPC code for a response carrying an embedded ErrorResult should route through this function rather than re-deriving the mapping from the raw HTTP code.
